notes: Stack Health was flagging the nightly Google Drive backup as a problem when the backup had actually worked. It counted every ERROR line in the log, but rclone records a retry that then succeeded as an ERROR too — so one brief hiccup talking to Google was enough to light up the row. It now only reports a backup as failed when a file genuinely didn't make it after retrying, which is the same rule the phone alert already used, so the two can't disagree any more. Retries that recovered are still shown, but on the green row rather than as a warning.
